svg.text: ED APP STARTER · BEGINNER DEPLOYMENT
Your idea. Your repo.
Your running app.
GitHub + Railway Hobby + a coding agent with tool access
ChatGPT/Codex or Hermes · subscriptions and access configured separately
COPY THE TEMPLATE
Create your own GitHub repository.
Keep new app repositories private by default.
BRIEF YOUR CODING AGENT
Share your app idea + the repo starter pack.
Authorize the correct GitHub and Railway accounts.
VERIFY THE FOUNDATION
Run the included tests with disposable PostgreSQL.
Green tests prove behavior; review SECURITY.md too.
RECREATE THE ENVIRONMENT
Railway: your app service + Postgres + persistent volume.
Apply Docker, migration and healthcheck settings.
SET SECRETS & DEPLOY
Generate fresh secrets. Connect the database by reference.
Create HTTPS domain → set APP_URL → deploy.
CHECK THE LIVE APP
Health checks → login → records → redeploy persistence.
Test backups before storing important data.
REUSE THE CONFIGURATION. GENERATE YOUR OWN ENVIRONMENT.
Fresh database, secrets and domain for every app. Never copy live credentials.
Known dependency advisory: read SECURITY.md before production use.
Railway usage may exceed the Hobby minimum. Set a budget and review costs.
github.com/isoenthusiast/ed-app-starter-public · Full steps: docs/BEGINNER_DEPLOYMENT.md
